title: After a simulator boots, a one-screen check proves the screen is live
why: Left from Home waiting-page item 86 (duo-sim-fix): a boot hook takes one screenshot after a sim boots and refuses a blank or black first frame, before a lane relies on the screen. Never handed off until now. Done when: the hook exists with a test that goes red on a blank or black first frame, or a ruling drops it. Home coordinator hand-off, relayed by the owner as ask ask-mw839r77zp (11:11 CST Nov 8; Home notes, PR 581). The owner is unsure all still hold, so the lane checks first.
note: Coordinator 11:16 CST Nov 8: lane started. Page item 433 (11:18 CST Nov 8): should sim-test boots get the same screen check (decision sim-boot-is-verified says they are not checked)? Pick a, in this lane. The lane builds the hook check meanwhile. Item 433: owner pressed none at 11:41 CST Nov 8, with a question ("you wont be able to check it boots cuz it's cloud session right?"), not a direction. Item stays open; triage answered on the page at 11:49 CST (the check runs on the Mac when sim-test boots; tests use a saved screenshot) and told the lane. Lane 11:50 CST: tests use PNGs built in code, not a saved screenshot; a real Duo screenshot has never gone through the judge and that run is owed on the Mac. Item 433 reply fixed 11:52 CST. Owner item 433 a (page answer 18:00Z = 12:00 CST Nov 8): check sim-test boots too, in this lane; routed to the lane, whose decision record (sim-boot-is-verified) is the home. Mac-session task after #2210 merges (lane 12:40 CST Nov 8, as the coordinator directed): (1) boot a Duo through `sim-test --hold --for 60`, run `xcrun simctl io <UDID> screenshot /tmp/duo.png`, read IHDR bytes 24-25 (bit depth, colour type), and confirm `python3 ~/.claude/hooks/sim_boot_record.py --check <UDID>` exits 0; (2) capture one real dead-display frame if one occurs and confirm `frame_uniform` returns True. Settles notes frame-judge-simctl-format-unread and sim-check-cold-boot-timeout; record cold boot times. Goes to a session on the Mac, through the sim gatekeeper.
